notes:
Refers to using up goods, energy, time, or other resources. In economics, it specifically refers to the consumption of goods and services by consumers, as opposed to production or saving.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}{者|しゃ}→消費者：09866_shouhisha⟧: consumer
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}{税|ぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧: consumption tax (sales tax)
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}{期限|きげん}→消費期限：06077_shouhikigen⟧: expiration date; use-by date
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: consumption volume
- ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧: personal consumption
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: consumer society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浪費|ろうひ}する→浪費する：25239_rouhisuru⟧: to waste; to squander — implies wasteful or excessive consumption
- ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use — a general word for using something, without the nuance of using it up
- ⟦{費|つい}やす→費やす：10424_tsuiyasu⟧: to spend; to expend — emphasizes the deliberate investment of time, effort, or money toward a purpose
